summary: Giving yourself an item with a Wind Burst enchantment level higher than 3, then hitting certain entities crashes the game
description: The bug Hitting certain entities (boats, end crystals, fireballs, players, minecarts, shulker bullets and wind charges) with an item enchanted with a Wind Burst level greater than 4 crashes the game. How to reproduce - Enter the following command in the chat: /give @s mace[minecraft:enchantments={levels:{ wind_burst :4}}] - Hit one of the mentioned entities with the mace (it will work with any item)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the chat window.  
2. Enter the command ``/give @p minecraft:mace[minecraft:enchantments={levels:{"minecraft:wind_burst":4}}]`` and press Enter.  
3. Locate a boat, end crystal, fireball, player, minecart, shulker bullet, or wind charge in the world.  
4. Equip the newly given mace.  
5. Hit the chosen entity with the mace.  
6. Observe that the game crashes.
Observed Behavior:
Actual behavior**

* When an item (any tool, weapon, or trident) is given the **Wind Burst** enchantment at **level 4** (or any level > 3) and the player strikes one of the following entities, the game **immediately crashes**:
  * Boats
  * End Crystals
  * Fireballs
  * Players
  * Minecarts (any type)
  * Shulker Bullets
  * Wind Charges

* The crash occurs **as soon as the hit is registered** – the attack animation may play, but the client (in single‑player) or the server (in multiplayer) aborts the current tick and generates a crash report.

* The generated crash report contains a stack‑trace that references the `WindBurstEnchantment` handler and the entity‑hit processing code, e.g.:

  ```
  *** *** *** Minecraft Crash Report *** *** ***
  Description: Exception while handling entity hit
  java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Enchantment level out of bounds (4 > 3)
      at net.minecraft.world.item.enchantment.WindBurstEnchantment.applyEffect(...)
      at net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity.hurt(...)
      …
  ```

* The crash is **reproducible** with any item that carries the enchantment, not only the mace. Using a lower level ( ≤ 3 ) does **not** cause a crash; the enchantment simply has no effect.

* The problem is limited to the listed entities. Hitting other mobs (e.g., zombies, skeletons) with a level‑4 Wind Burst item does **not** trigger the crash.

* In multiplayer, the server throws the same exception and disconnects all players; the client receives a “Disconnected” screen with the crash log attached.

* The issue appears in the latest snapshot/build (as of the report date) and has been confirmed by multiple testers using the exact command:

  ```
  /give @p minecraft:mace[minecraft:enchantments={levels:{"minecraft:wind_burst":4}}]
  ```

* No other side‑effects (such as damage or knock‑back) are observed before the crash; the game terminates before the normal Wind Burst effect would be applied.
Expected Behavior: When a player gives themselves a mace (or any item) enchanted with Wind Burst level 4 using the command and then strikes one of the listed entities (boat, end crystal, fireball, player, minecart, shulker bullet, wind charge), the game should continue running and the Wind Burst effect should activate normally—launching or applying knock‑back as intended—without causing a crash or freezing.
